outcome: A single, lifecycle-managed platform that consolidates the server estate and simplifies day-to-day operations.
overview: A manufacturer with ageing servers usually has two problems that look like one: hardware past its support life, and a virtual machine estate that grew without anyone deciding it should. PowerEdge with VxRail addresses the first properly and gives an opportunity to address the second, because a migration is the only moment anyone reviews what is actually running. The consolidation ratio is where the business case lives, and it comes from the measured workload profile rather than from a rule of thumb about virtual machines per host.

benefits.text: Ageing servers past support are replaced with a supported, lifecycle-managed platform
benefits.limits: Sized from measured capacity and performance data; a design built on invoice history or on projected growth alone produces a quotation rather than an architecture

benefits.text: Compute, storage and virtualisation are managed as one lifecycle instead of three
benefits.limits: Lifecycle integration is with a specific hypervisor; changing hypervisor later is a re-platforming exercise rather than a configuration change

benefits.text: The migration forces a review of what is actually running, which usually removes machines
benefits.limits: Only where a decommission decision is actually taken; migrating everything preserves the sprawl at a newer cost base

residency: Entirely on customer-owned equipment in the customer data centre

notFor.situation: An estate committed to a different hyperconverged platform
notFor.why: Lifecycle integration is platform-specific and does not extend across two different platforms

notFor.situation: A workload set that is mostly containerised
notFor.why: A virtualisation-centric refresh serves a virtual machine estate; container platforms have different requirements

scope:
Model: Redington solutions engineering with an accredited Dell implementation partner · Duration: 10–16 weeks to a migrated estate, hardware lead time excluded
Support model: Vendor hardware and software support with a replacement term matched to workload criticality; Redington coordinates the vendor case. Optional managed operations.
1) Assessment — inventory, measured capacity and performance, facility constraints
2) Design — sizing, migration waves and the decommission decision framework
3) Build — nodes deployed, storage and virtualisation layers established
4) Migrate and hand over — workloads migrated with decommission decisions recorded, operations handed over
deliverables: Delivered capacity matches the sizing report against measured workload data
Every migrated workload carries a recorded keep-or-decommission decision
A platform upgrade is completed as one validated operation during handover
